coverage.verificationRule: Active recommendations require current evidence. Prefer primary employer/ATS/university/public sources; job boards are discovery sources. Board-only candidates without sufficient current verification are not treated as fully verified recommendations.
coverage.freshnessRule: Fresh means the exact vacancy fingerprint was not present in prior archived reports.
coverage.candidateRule: The portal publishes only roles that survive the candidate-specific 0-years gate and meaningful technical/CV match. Broad portal counts such as Jobvector's 929 Medizintechnik vacancies are discovery universes, not publishable results.
coverage.searchMethod: Search everywhere relevant for maximum recall; apply the fixed 15-portal Germany baseline plus broader source layers; build a broad candidate pool; deduplicate; verify current status; adjudicate strict 0-years suitability; score actual CV-to-job technical fit; assess language and work authorization; compare against history; run a false-negative hunt; publish only qualifying roles.
coverage.acceptanceAssessment: PASS for the expanded-source acceptance refresh. The search universe was widened without widening the publication criteria. The active published set increased from 16 to 18 because two additional current vacancies passed the candidate-specific gates. No generic job-board inventory was published merely because it was discoverable.
limitations: Search engines and portals expose different subsets and metadata
Not every portal exposes every result to the web index on every run
No single run can honestly claim 100% recall across every European vacancy
Work authorization remains country/role-specific unless explicitly verified
Job-board result counts are inventory indicators, not candidate-fit counts
Several discovered opportunities were deliberately excluded because of experience, language, technical-fit or verification conflicts
